description: Research EMRs for US primary-care or behavioral-health practices with 1–10 clinicians. Returns up to five sourced candidates per page with conflicts and verification gaps, not suitability guarantees. Use next_offset to see remaining candidates in the selected catalog. No contact details or patient data; does not create or deliver leads.

clinician_count.description: Number of practicing clinicians, excluding administrative staff.

monthly_budget_usd.description: Total monthly practice budget in USD. Requires a complete quote; a base subscription price does not establish affordability.
